title: How to improve an Australian rental application
excerpt: Rental applications in Australia are not a matter of luck, but a decision-making process that can be improved. ## Renting in Australia: How Can You Improve Your Application Success Rate?

Published: 2025-10-26

Estimated reading time: 6 minutes

Author: Qrent Team

Tags: Renting in Australia, international student rentals, application success rate, rental applications, Sydney rentals, Melbourne rentals

---

## I. Background and the Questions People Ask

Every year, countless international students arrive in Australia, only to get stuck at the first step of renting—

> "I've applied for several properties and haven't heard anything."

"The agent keeps saying, 'The landlord chose someone else.'"

Rental applications in Australia are highly competitive, especially during the start-of-term periods in Sydney and Melbourne,

when popular properties often receive over a hundred applications within 24 hours.

The Qrent team has compiled the screening criteria of major Australian agencies (Domain, Realestate, LJ Hooker, etc.),

combined them with platform user data, and put together a practical guide for international students:

**How to improve your chances of approval and make landlords more willing to choose you.**

---

## II. The Three Core Elements of a Successful Rental Application

| Core element | What the landlord values | Qrent's suggestion |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Financial capacity | Whether you can reliably pay the rent | Provide clear bank statements or a guarantor letter |
| Responsibility as a resident | Whether you will care for the property, be quiet and honour the agreement | Include rental references and a brief application letter |
| Application completeness | Whether documents are properly prepared and complete | Organise them in the official format and submit everything together |

💡 In a landlord's eyes, a "clear, complete and credible" application is more persuasive than any description of yourself.

---

## III. Preparing Documents: Complete and Professional

The following documents are essential when applying for a property:

**1️⃣ Identity documents**

- Passport

- Visa page or Confirmation of Enrolment (CoE)

- Student card / proof of enrolment

**2️⃣ Financial evidence**

- Bank statements (for the past three months)

- Guarantor Letter or proof of savings

- If you have a part-time job: Payslip or employment contract

**3️⃣ Rental history / references**

- A Rental Reference from a previous landlord or agent

- If you are renting for the first time, you can ask a teacher or guardian to provide a reference

**Qrent's suggestion**:

Combine all documents into one PDF and give it a clear name (such as "XXX （Name)_Rental_Application.pdf"),

making it easier for the agent to review and demonstrating that you are professional and attentive to detail.

---

## IV. A Rental Application Letter Adds to Your Application

Australian landlords place considerable importance on communication and the impression you make.

A short, sincere application letter can effectively improve your competitiveness.

📝 **English template example:**

> Dear Agent,

My name is XXX, currently studying at XXX.

I am a responsible and tidy tenant who always pays rent on time.

I love the location and would take great care of the property.

Thank you for your consideration.

💡 Note: There is no need to write at length; a sincere, natural tone is enough.

---

## V. Timing and Strategy Matter Too

1. **Apply early**: The chances of approval for popular listings are highest when applying within 24 hours of publication.

1. **Apply immediately after the Inspection**: Submitting an application on the spot after viewing the property demonstrates your interest.

1. **Keep communication polite**: If there are updates, you can email the agent to ask about progress.

1. **Apply for 3–5 properties at a time**: Balance efficiency and choice, rather than putting all your eggs in one basket.

---

---

## VII. Summary and Key Takeaways

- Australian rental applications emphasise "financial capacity + responsibility + complete documents";

- Prepare the three core types of documents in advance: identity, banking and references;

- Including a short application letter can significantly improve your chances of approval;

- Try to submit your application within 24 hours of the inspection;

- Use Qrent's tools to analyse area average prices and competition, and make more rational choices.

Qrent's suggestion:

> Prepare one step ahead of others, and you can get the keys sooner.

Smart listing filters + data-based price comparisons give every application a better chance.
